texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 1. Introduction
texts.text: 1. Introduction

texts.label: text
texts.orig: This document sets the daily spending limits for hotels and meals during business travel at Nexora Technologies Ltd. It is a companion to the Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy (NX-FIN-POL-012).  The  limits  are  tied  to  the  employee's  grade  and  to  the  tier  of  the  city  visited, because the cost of a reasonable hotel room or a sensible meal in Mumbai is very different from the cost in Madurai.
texts.text: This document sets the daily spending limits for hotels and meals during business travel at Nexora Technologies Ltd. It is a companion to the Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy (NX-FIN-POL-012).  The  limits  are  tied  to  the  employee's  grade  and  to  the  tier  of  the  city  visited, because the cost of a reasonable hotel room or a sensible meal in Mumbai is very different from the cost in Madurai.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The limits are caps and not entitlements. An employee is reimbursed the actual cost up to the cap, and any spend above the cap is borne by the employee unless an exception is approved under the Approval Rules and Exceptions document (NX-FIN-POL-014). Limits include all taxes and service charges unless stated otherwise.
texts.text: The limits are caps and not entitlements. An employee is reimbursed the actual cost up to the cap, and any spend above the cap is borne by the employee unless an exception is approved under the Approval Rules and Exceptions document (NX-FIN-POL-014). Limits include all taxes and service charges unless stated otherwise.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Limits are reviewed every year in March by the Finance Controller with input from HR and the travel desk, using hotel rate data from the previous 12 months. The version in force on the day an expense is incurred applies to that expense.
texts.text: Limits are reviewed every year in March by the Finance Controller with input from HR and the travel desk, using hotel rate data from the previous 12 months. The version in force on the day an expense is incurred applies to that expense.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 2. City Tier Classification
texts.text: 2. City Tier Classification

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Every destination is placed in one of four tiers. Tier 1 covers the largest and most expensive business cities. Tier 2 covers other large cities. Tier 3 covers all other Indian cities and towns, including any city not named below. International destinations form their own tier.
texts.text: Every destination is placed in one of four tiers. Tier 1 covers the largest and most expensive business cities. Tier 2 covers other large cities. Tier 3 covers all other Indian cities and towns, including any city not named below. International destinations form their own tier.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: When a trip includes several cities, each night and each day is assessed against the city where the employee stays or works that day. When a city is within 40 kilometres of a Tier 1 city and the hotel is chosen  for  proximity  to  the  customer  site,  the  Tier  1  limit  applies.  The  Finance  Controller  may reclassify a city during the year if hotel rates change materially, and will publish the change on the intranet 30 days before it takes effect.
texts.text: When a trip includes several cities, each night and each day is assessed against the city where the employee stays or works that day. When a city is within 40 kilometres of a Tier 1 city and the hotel is chosen  for  proximity  to  the  customer  site,  the  Tier  1  limit  applies.  The  Finance  Controller  may reclassify a city during the year if hotel rates change materially, and will publish the change on the intranet 30 days before it takes effect.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 3. Hotel Limits by Grade
texts.text: 3. Hotel Limits by Grade

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The hotel limit is the maximum room rate per night, inclusive of GST and service charges, for a single occupancy room. Breakfast included in the room rate is covered within the hotel limit and breakfast must then not be claimed separately under meals.
texts.text: The hotel limit is the maximum room rate per night, inclusive of GST and service charges, for a single occupancy room. Breakfast included in the room rate is covered within the hotel limit and breakfast must then not be claimed separately under meals.

texts.orig: 4. Hotel Booking Rules

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 4.1 Preferred hotels and channels
texts.text: 4.1 Preferred hotels and channels

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The travel desk maintains a list of preferred hotels in each major city with negotiated rates that are almost  always  below  the  cap.  Employees  should  choose  from  this  list.  A  hotel  outside  the  list  is allowed  when  the  rate  is  within  the  cap  and  the  property  is  a  recognised  business  hotel;  where proximity to a client site is the reason, exception EX-08 may be used.
texts.text: The travel desk maintains a list of preferred hotels in each major city with negotiated rates that are almost  always  below  the  cap.  Employees  should  choose  from  this  list.  A  hotel  outside  the  list  is allowed  when  the  rate  is  within  the  cap  and  the  property  is  a  recognised  business  hotel;  where proximity to a client site is the reason, exception EX-08 may be used.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 4.2 Rules
texts.text: 4.2 Rules

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Single occupancy only. Employees of the same gender and grade band travelling together are encouraged to share a twin room, and the cap for the room is then the sum of both limits.
texts.text: Single occupancy only. Employees of the same gender and grade band travelling together are encouraged to share a twin room, and the cap for the room is then the sum of both limits.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Only business nights are reimbursed. The night before an early meeting and the night after a late meeting qualify if travel on the same day is not practical.
texts.text: Only business nights are reimbursed. The night before an early meeting and the night after a late meeting qualify if travel on the same day is not practical.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Hotel invoices must carry the Company's GSTIN. Hotels outside the preferred list must provide a tax invoice, not a booking confirmation.
texts.text: Hotel invoices must carry the Company's GSTIN. Hotels outside the preferred list must provide a tax invoice, not a booking confirmation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Room upgrades, suites, club lounges, spa and minibar are not reimbursed.
texts.text: Room upgrades, suites, club lounges, spa and minibar are not reimbursed.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Cancellations should be made at least 24 hours in advance. No-show and late-cancellation charges are reimbursed only when the reason was beyond the employee's control.
texts.text: Cancellations should be made at least 24 hours in advance. No-show and late-cancellation charges are reimbursed only when the reason was beyond the employee's control.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Loyalty points earned on Company-paid stays belong to the employee, but must not influence the choice of hotel.
texts.text: Loyalty points earned on Company-paid stays belong to the employee, but must not influence the choice of hotel.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · If the hotel includes breakfast, the employee may not claim a separate breakfast.
texts.text: If the hotel includes breakfast, the employee may not claim a separate breakfast.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Where no hotel within the cap is available, the employee may book the nearest alternative and raise exception EX-02, attaching a screenshot showing the unavailable inventory.
texts.text: Where no hotel within the cap is available, the employee may book the nearest alternative and raise exception EX-02, attaching a screenshot showing the unavailable inventory.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 5. Meal Limits by Grade
texts.text: 5. Meal Limits by Grade

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The meal limit is  the  maximum amount reimbursable for all meals on one calendar day while the employee is travelling, inclusive of taxes and service charges. It covers breakfast, lunch, dinner and non-alcoholic beverages and snacks.
texts.text: The meal limit is  the  maximum amount reimbursable for all meals on one calendar day while the employee is travelling, inclusive of taxes and service charges. It covers breakfast, lunch, dinner and non-alcoholic beverages and snacks.

texts.orig: The split is a guide only. An employee may spend more on dinner and less on breakfast as long as the total for the day stays within the daily limit.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 6. Meal Rules
texts.text: 6. Meal Rules

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · The daily limit applies to every calendar day of the trip, including the day of departure and the day of return.
texts.text: The daily limit applies to every calendar day of the trip, including the day of departure and the day of return.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Meals provided by the customer, the conference or the hotel package must not be claimed. If a meal is provided for part of a day, the daily limit is reduced by the share of that meal.
texts.text: Meals provided by the customer, the conference or the hotel package must not be claimed. If a meal is provided for part of a day, the daily limit is reduced by the share of that meal.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Alcohol, tobacco and similar items are never reimbursed, even if they are part of a combined bill. Finance deducts them.
texts.text: Alcohol, tobacco and similar items are never reimbursed, even if they are part of a combined bill. Finance deducts them.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Where a team eats together, the senior employee pays and claims, listing the names of all attendees. The per-person cost is tested against the daily limit of each attendee's grade.
texts.text: Where a team eats together, the senior employee pays and claims, listing the names of all attendees. The per-person cost is tested against the daily limit of each attendee's grade.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Client entertainment is not a personal meal. It is claimed as Client Entertainment, with a limit of INR 2,500 per head, and does not use up the daily meal limit.
texts.text: Client entertainment is not a personal meal. It is claimed as Client Entertainment, with a limit of INR 2,500 per head, and does not use up the daily meal limit.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Meals for a day of one-way travel starting after 2 pm or ending before 11 am are limited to dinner or lunch respectively.
texts.text: Meals for a day of one-way travel starting after 2 pm or ending before 11 am are limited to dinner or lunch respectively.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Receipts are needed for each meal above INR 300. Up to INR 300 per day can be declared without a receipt, subject to INR 1,000 per month.
texts.text: Receipts are needed for each meal above INR 300. Up to INR 300 per day can be declared without a receipt, subject to INR 1,000 per month.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Exceeding the limit because of customer hosting can be approved under exception EX-03, with the guest list attached.
texts.text: Exceeding the limit because of customer hosting can be approved under exception EX-03, with the guest list attached.

texts.label: text

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 10. Extended Stays
texts.text: 10. Extended Stays

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A stay of up to 14 consecutive nights at one location is covered by the standard limits. For longer stays the employee should consider a serviced apartment or a monthly rate. Stays between 15 and 45 nights need exception EX-12, for which the hotel cap is reduced by 15 percent from the 15th night, since monthly rates are cheaper. Meal limits for extended stays are reduced by 20 percent from the 15th day, and the employee is encouraged to use kitchen facilities.

Meal limits for extended stays are reduced by 20 percent from the 15th day, and the employee is encouraged to use kitchen facilities.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Assignments longer than 45 nights are treated as temporary relocation and are governed by the HR Mobility Policy, not by this document.

texts.orig: 12. Handling Breaches
texts.text: 12. Handling Breaches

texts.label: text
texts.orig: When a claim contains an hotel or meal amount above the limit, the Expense Portal marks the line as "Exceeds limit". The employee then has three options: accept the reduction, correct the item if there is an error, or request an exception with a written justification. The reporting manager cannot waive the limit alone.

texts.label: text

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: Is the hotel cap per night or per trip?

texts.orig: Q: Does the cap include GST?

texts.orig: A: Yes. The limits are inclusive of all taxes and service charges.

texts.orig: 14. Special Situations

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 14.1 Safety and accessibility
texts.text: 14.1 Safety and accessibility

texts.label: text
texts.orig: An employee may choose a hotel above the cap for safety  reasons,  for  example  when  travelling alone late at night or when the cheaper hotels near the meeting are in locations the travel desk has flagged as unsafe. The employee should note the reason in the claim and select exception EX-02 or EX-09  where  relevant.  Employees  with  accessibility  needs,  or  those  travelling  with  medical equipment, may be reimbursed for a suitable room above the cap with the approval of HR and the Finance Controller.

texts.orig: 16. Monitoring and Review

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Finance publishes a monthly dashboard showing the average hotel rate and the average meal spend per grade and tier, the percentage of items above limit, and the number of exceptions by code. The dashboard is shared with department heads. A department whose items exceed limits more than 15 percent of the time must present an action plan to the CFO.
